start.description: Start of token range. {@link Cassandra.Node} token value must be greater than or equal to this and less than {@link #end}

end.description: End of token range. {@link Cassandra.Node} token value must be less than this and greater than or equal to {@link #start}

title: Identifies token range to use for {@link Cassandra.Node#rebuild} and {@link Cassandra.Node#repair}
name: Cassandra.Node.TokenRange
